# What names SE or one host under kern/: the move to its own repository's to-do list
# (moveout_test.go). One pattern per line: a kind, whitespace, a Go regular expression.
# A place on a line is listed once, under the first kind in this file whose pattern matches it,
# so the narrower kinds come first.

# SE's workflows, reused by address or named as files in SE's .github/
se-workflow     [\w.-]+/SE/\.github/workflows/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(@[^\s"'`)\]]*)?
se-workflow     \.github/workflows/(kern|se)-[a-z0-9_-]+\.yml
# release addresses of SE's repository
se-release      [\w.-]+/SE/releases/[^\s"'`)\]\\]*
# every other address of SE's repository or its documentation site
se-repository   [\w-]+\.github\.io/SE[^\s"'`)\]]*
se-repository   [\w.-]+/SE\b[^\s"'`)\]]*
# links into SE's documents, relative to kern/
se-doc-link     (\.\./)+(docs|src|scripts|tests|README\.md|AGENTS\.md)[^\s"'`)\]]*
# SE's variables
se-variable     \bSE_[A-Z0-9_]+
# SE's files and folders
se-file         \bse\.toml\b
se-file         \.se/[a-z_-]+
se-file         \bscripts/[a-z_]+\.(py|sh|ps1)\b
# one host's variables, hook shape and tool names
host-variable   \bCLAUDE_[A-Z0-9_]+
host-hook       \b(PreToolUse|PostToolUse|UserPromptSubmit|SessionStart|SessionEnd|SubagentStop|PreCompact)\b
host-hook       \b(hookSpecificOutput|additionalContext|permissionDecision)\b
host-hook       \btool_(name|input|response)\b
host-hook       \bmcp__[a-z0-9]+__
host-hook       "(Bash|PowerShell)"
# one host's folders
host-folder     \.claude(-plugin)?/
host-folder     \.github/(agents|skills|hooks)/
host-folder     \.copilot/
# SE by name, in prose
se-name         \bSE\b
